chronic_issues.symptoms: Sweet maple syrup odor after hard driving; gradual loss of coolant level in expansion tank.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Check upper plastic seam of tank located in the left rear engine compartment for white chalky residue.

chronic_issues.component: LDF Transmission Clutch Pack Wear (Launch Counter)
chronic_issues.symptoms: Clutch hesitation in 1st/reverse, jerky low-speed maneuvering.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Demand dealer ODIS / Leonardo diagnostic report showing exact launch control count and clutch touch point millimeter wear.

chronic_issues.symptoms: Hissing behind dashboard vents; AC blows warm air despite refrigerant recharge.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Requires full interior dashboard removal. Sniff air vents immediately upon AC startup.

must_have_options.name: Front Suspension Lifting System

must_have_options.name: Carbon Fiber Exterior Lower & Upper Packages

must_have_options.name: T-Shaped Engine Cover & X-Frame in Carbon

must_have_options.name: Sensonum Premium Audio System
must_have_options.description: Better acoustic output, although most buyers listen to the 8,250 RPM V12 sound.

chronic_issues.symptoms: Clutch slippage in Corsa mode, gear engagement fault warning on dashboard, smell of burning friction material.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: MANDATORY: Run a Lamborghini Lara/Leonardo diagnostic tool check. A clutch reading below 25% requires an immediate $20,000 price deduction because the engine must be pulled out.

chronic_issues.symptoms: Clunking or rattling noise over expansion joints; unequal ride height.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Inspect pushrod horizontal spring mounts and check for oil weeping along damper shaft.

chronic_issues.component: Fuel Tank Evaporative Vent System (Recall Campaign)
chronic_issues.symptoms: Fuel vapors venting near hot exhaust in high RPM over-rev, fire hazard with aftermarket catless pipes.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Verify official Lamborghini Safety Recall L616 (EVAP canister & purge valve update) was completed in authorized service records.

chronic_issues.component: Scissor Door Hydraulic Lift Gas Struts
chronic_issues.symptoms: Scissor doors fail to stay elevated or feel overly heavy to open.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Open both doors and let go at 45 degrees. They should glide smoothly upward without assistance.
